question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The corporator gathered heaps of curses, and his __misdeeds__ can never be forgiven by the people.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"misdeeds"** refers to bad or immoral actions that are wrong or sinful. (कुकर्म)

 
 
• **Example:** His misdeeds during his term in office were widely criticized.
 
 
 
• **"Transgressions"** are violations of laws, rules, or moral codes. It refers to actions that go beyond acceptable limits. (उल्लंघन)
 
 
• **Example:** The transgressions committed by the employee led to strict disciplinary action.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of "misdeeds" is "transgressions."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Consequences** (परिणाम): The results or effects of an action or decision.

 
 
• **Example:** He faced severe consequences for his reckless behavior.
 
 
 
• **Arguments** (तर्क): Explanations or points put forth to support or oppose something.
 
 
• **Example:** Their arguments during the debate were well-reasoned and convincing.
 
 
 
• **Confrontation** (मुठभेड़): A direct conflict or face-to-face encounter, often involving opposition.
 
 
• **Example:** The confrontation between the two leaders escalated quickly.
